Brig. General Don Bulduc Campaign Video for SOF PAC Fund

The Good General is a Man I strive to be like, he always walks into uncertainty and with the odds against him and never quits til he gets to his goal and mission objective. 

Very soon I will be help his campaign. 

Here is a interesting fact about the General, Brigadier Buldoc did not have the big party support in his Senate Campaign at First, and neither did I when we started with SOF PAC. But we earned it by being transparent, tenacious and willing to support others first.

He is a man of Tremendous Character. I’ proud to be associated with many in this Community. I owe them success and to raise the flag in support of them. 

Respect & Honor 🇺🇸
